name: Tachibana Ota
source:
Part of unit Hot-Blood

Always speaking in a loud voice, he is an enthusiastic person who goes at his own pace.
He can never read the mood, but he never has any ill intent and is a junior who is loved by everyone.
When he gets hungry, his personality suddenly becomes very aggressive.
